observations: Original Sony PlayStation 4 console (fat model) with a two-tone matte and glossy finish.
The glossy section of the console top is heavily scratched in photo 0.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are present in photo 1.
The black controller in photo 1 is missing the rubber thumbstick cover on the left analog stick.
The camo controller appears to be in better physical condition than the black one.
Watermark 'OBATEK GLOBAL' appears on both photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows significant scratching on the glossy faceplate, and photo 1 shows a damaged controller stick.
No photos of game discs or the console's digital library screen were provided.
These titles do not exist as official releases (FC 25 is the current naming); they are likely patches on a jailbroken console which is not proven by photos.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may have the smaller 500GB hard drive rather than 1TB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may suffer from 'stick drift' or internal wear.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate menus without ghost inputs.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo showing the console successfully logged into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Photo of the system storage information screen.
Photo of the home screen showing the installed games list.
Video of the console running a game to verify fan noise and disc drive functionality.
response.reason: The item is a standard original PS4. While the condition is poor (scratched and one damaged controller) and the games are unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a functional but cosmetically damaged 500GB unit.
